title: Defrost a C. elegans Strain from the -80 C Freezer
author: Cristian Riccio
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.5xug7nw
materials: Put the tube in a foam floater.

steps.title: Retrieve frozen worm tube
steps.instruction: Take the frozen C. elegans tube out of the –80 °C freezer.

steps.title: Prepare lukewarm water bath
steps.instruction: Put the foam floater on the surface of lukewarm water in a beaker.

steps.title: Defrost and transfer worms
steps.instruction: When the tube content has defrosted (a few minutes), pour the contents onto an NGM plate seeded with bacteria.

steps.title: Incubate plate
steps.instruction: Place the plate in a plastic box and put the box into an incubator (e.g., at 20 °C).

steps.title: Check worm viability
steps.instruction: The following day, verify that worms are alive; aim for at least 60 living pre‑reproductive or reproductive worms on the plate.
